# DocChat AI — LLM Information File
# https://docchat-saas.vercel.app

## About
DocChat AI is an AI-powered document analysis platform. Users upload PDFs, DOCX, Excel, CSV and 10+ file formats and ask natural language questions across multiple documents simultaneously.

## Key Features
- Chat with multiple PDFs (up to 5 simultaneously)
- AI Excel and spreadsheet analyzer
- Contract review AI
- Advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture
- Multiple AI models: Llama 3.1 70B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek R1
- Follow-up prompt suggestions
- Document comparison mode
- Auto-summarize on upload
- Export chat history

## Pricing
- Starter: Free (15 docs/month, 100 questions/month)
- Pro: $19/month (unlimited documents and questions)
- Business: $49/month (API access, priority support)
- Annual discount: 20% off

Legal contract review, financial report analysis, healthcare research, academic research, AI Excel analyzer, technical documentation

## Supported Formats
PDF, DOCX, TXT, XLSX, CSV, Markdown, HTML, RTF, EPUB, ODT
